review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Implement read-only actual association diagnostics and source-owned automatic recovery of a missing primary index after its own proof aged out
review.notes: User reported repeated unassociated sessions and asked doctor identification/self-healing after180 normal resume. Current57 exact180/strict+App interfaces independently read200 verified; no real fault injection or actor restart. Doctor must not guess sessions from history, manufacture fresh proof, bypass5s reader freshness, alter roles/config/queue or silently restart active agents. Recovery belongs to the already authenticated producer normal heartbeat, not a new doctor write/control protocol: require saved==previous in-memory exact owner, current process self, missing physical primary index (not unknown/malformed incumbent), full strict rebased process/TTY/root/backend identity, bounded conservative receipt-store scan rejecting fresh/newer/ambiguous/unknown owners, existing epoch/context and shared publication lease. Only missing-index expired-proof case is extended; existing location and first-root contracts remain. No new MCP/socket/polling/control authority, no automatic old-binary reload. Legacy/unsupported capabilities remain explicitly distinguished. Design precedes new tests. Old main production overlay must be meaningful assertion red rather than compile/environment red; all original valid guards preserved. Hardware/realTTY/continuous runtime not claimed.
